Description:
  Generate C# models from OData 4.0 or 4.01 XML metadata.

Usage:
  dotnet-nextorm odata-models [options]

Options:
  --metadata <metadata> (REQUIRED)    The HTTP(S) metadata URL or path to an EDMX XML file.
  --namespace <namespace> (REQUIRED)  The C# namespace prefix for the OData schema namespaces.
  --output <output> (REQUIRED)        The output C# file path.
  --force                             Replace a file generated by this command.
  -?, -h, --help                      Show help and usage information
